# btpservice_ctms_destinations (Data Source)

Reads all transport destination summaries in name order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "btpservice_ctms_destinations" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `values` (Attributes List) Destination summaries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `application` (String) Application, if returned.
- `data_center` (String) Data center, if returned.
- `description` (String) Destination description, if returned.
- `name` (String) Destination name.
- `platform_types` (List of String) Platform types in API order.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Destination URL. Redacted because URLs may contain credentials; sensitive output is still stored in state.
